mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_daily_plan_override (batch_id, factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, terminal_type, supply_mode, path_group_key, schedule_date, manual_quantity, reason, revision, operator_id) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{factoryCode}, #{rootMaterialCode}, #{terminalMaterialCode}, #{terminalType}, #{supplyMode}, #{pathGroupKey}, #{scheduleDate}, #{manualQuantity}, #{reason}, #{revision}, #{operatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_daily_plan_override SET manual_quantity=#{manualQuantity}, reason=#{reason}, revision=#{revision}, operator_id=#{operatorId} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_daily_plan_override WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY factory_code, root_material_code, terminal_material_code, schedule_date
